title: Did not clean nearly as well as my handheld Shark vacuum
text: Did not clean nearly as well as my handheld Shark vacuum. Thought it worked well at first, but upon closer examination, it did not even pick up the majority of pet hair I had on hardwood floors. Vacuumed the same area directly after the roomba ran, and picked up a lot of pet hair. A vacuum bought at Walmart for around $200 should NOT perform better than an $800 vacuum. Would not recommend.
